## Pull Request Summary

Describe the changes proposed in this pull request and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change

- `feat`: New user-facing tool, category, or agent skill
- `fix`: Bug patch or regression fix
- `docs`: Documentation, README, or rule update
- `refactor`: Internal code refactoring without behavioral impact
- `perf`: Performance improvement
- `test`: Adding or correcting tests
- `chore`: Repository maintenance or tooling update

## Verification Gate

Confirm that your changes satisfy the repository engineering standards:

- [ ] All commit messages adhere to Conventional Commits: `<type>(<scope>): <subject>`
- [ ] `./toolbox audit check` passes with 0 errors and 0 warnings
- [ ] No numbered headings, parenthetical headings, or trailing punctuation in markdown files
- [ ] All intra-document links resolve with zero broken references
- [ ] Updated `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and relevant skills concurrently
